purpose: Teach: 智子/秀夫/美香/花園/小人/夫君/姐/追い出し

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「智子おばさんはお花が上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me that Tomoko-san is really skilled with flowers.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Speaking as an older sister sharing something she learned. Gentle cadence, like she's passing along a small kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと秀夫おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went with Dad and Uncle Hideo today.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Quick pace, innocent enthusiasm. The simple pride of sharing what happened. No filter between experience and telling.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「美香いとこを誘って一緒に遊ぼう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying we should invite Mika over and play together sometime.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful delivery. Pauses slightly before 'Mika' — considering. Warm undertone, like she's thinking of what would make him happy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと公園の花園を散策したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the flower garden at the park with Dad.
lines.style: Animated, childlike wonder in the delivery. Slight lift in pitch on 'flower garden.' Quick and genuine, like he's still excited from the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「子供向け絵本の小人達のお話を読もう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad suggested we read some children's picture books together — ones with those little dwarf stories in them.
lines.style: Soft, inviting tone. Speaking slowly enough to set a cozy scene. Slight warmth suggesting this is something she thinks he'll enjoy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「ママの夫君を支える」って言葉を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me a new word today — the idea of supporting the person Mom chose.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly formal in the way children sound when they've learned something 'grown-up.' Quiet respect in the delivery. A pause before the concept, like he's proud to understand it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「姐さんって呼び方は時代劇によく出る」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was explaining to me how the word 'older sister' — that formal way of saying it — comes up a lot in historical dramas.
lines.style: Patient, explanatory tone. Like she's enjoying teaching him something small and specific. Slight warmth under the educational register.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと先輩の追い出し会を一緒に手伝ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I helped out with the farewell party for the seniors today.
lines.style: Proud, accomplished closing. Steady pace with quiet confidence. The warmth of having done something grown-up and helpful. Slight lift at the end — pleased with himself.
